card.name: The word guess in classroom games
card.fires_on: The word "guess" or the following "Who" in the title "Guess Who?" and in classroom activities where students guess a described picture. It also fires weakly on casual "guess" or "look" in dialogue.

modes.label: Guessing in activities
modes.description: The word guess used as a verb in student describe-and-guess tasks.
modes.example: The students describe in writing one of the pictures (faces work really well). They read and the other students listen and “<<guess>>” which picture is being described.

modes.label: Casual spoken guess
modes.description: Informal guess or look right after a comma in chatty or scripted speech.
modes.example: Hey, Tyler,<< look>> what I've got.

card.plain: It lights up on the word "guess", mostly in the game name "Guess Who?" in teaching activity text.
